title: Invertibility and base change of the Kummer-normalized two-component maps
statement: Under the hypotheses and coefficient conventions of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-data], fix a normalized twist transport and a family of projective-line Chern arrows satisfying the actual Kummer specification [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class]. The map with components the shifted twisted unit and the adjoint Chern arrow is an isomorphism for every Noetherian base. For every map of such bases its square with the canonical exchange [def-kun-unbounded-exchange], normalized shifted-line comparison and ordered sum comparison commutes. This statement asserts neither a trace adjunction nor its triangular identities.

proof.text: Compute deg O(1)=1 from the two-chart coherent cohomology of O(d), Euler characteristic and the definition of degree. The adopted proper-curve degree trace therefore sends the actual Kummer boundary of O(1) to one. The genus-zero calculation identifies the roots-of-unity cohomology in degrees zero and two and makes the other degrees vanish.

proof.text: Pass to an arbitrary finite coefficient group killed by N using the constant-coefficient generator theorem. A primitive root trivializes the finite Tate line. The line universal property and the fact that endomorphisms of a constant rank-one module are scalar multiplication show that scalar multiples of the actual Kummer class biject with its degree-two cohomology. The cyclic-coefficient criterion similarly gives vanishing for arbitrary finite coefficients outside degrees zero and two.

proof.text: Apply the existing normalized twisted-unit exchange equation and Chern-adjunct exchange equation to the supplied transport and the two Chern arrows. Their Chern specifications are exactly the supplied family specification. Additivity of inverse image and the biproduct universal property combine the two component equations into the displayed ordered decomposition square. These are the stated component lemmas, used without duplicating their root-generator, Kummer-pullback or mate proofs.

source.place: Geometric-fibre calculation and compatibility of its two components with base change

proof.text: On an algebraically closed fibre, the infinity section splits the shifted twisted unit, so its map on degree minus two homology is monic. The degree-two generator calculation shows that the Chern component is faithful under scalar multiplication and hence monic on degree zero homology. In both degrees source and target have the cardinality of the coefficient ring, so these monomorphisms are isomorphisms. All other homology objects vanish. Thus the fibre biproduct map is an isomorphism. Proper exchange and invertibility of the source comparison transport this fibre result to geometric pullbacks over every Noetherian base; their conservativity proves the relative map is an isomorphism. Together with the component square above this proves the unchanged conjunction. The geometric-point scalar-faithfulness criterion and the explicitly constructed homology/global-cohomology comparison are recorded as proved APIs in their own modules to avoid repeatedly checking derived localization conversions.
